fields.name: selected_target
fields.description: Store one [y, x] point identifying the target on which the goal-named cube was placed at the goal-requested ordinal during the demonstration. Count completed placements onto targets chronologically, not frames, initial cube positions, flyovers, button presses, or the final release onto the unmarked central workspace. Identify a placement by lowering the carried cube onto a target and releasing it. Use the selected target's center in the first execution scene as the canonical stored point, matching its identity across occlusion and small apparent coordinate shifts. Write this point at decision step #1 and retain it unchanged at every subsequent decision step. For episodes 18, 22, 46, 49, and 60 respectively, the values at both steps are [116, 163], [114, 168], [122, 132], [108, 87], and [136, 82]. e.g. [116, 163]
